hierarchy: 1 real photos/archival · 2 editorial compositions · 3 supporting graphics · 4 atmosphere

b0a.motion: slow push-in on the newsroom; envelope static
b0a.why: The film opens on the documented July 31 1969 fact: three newspapers, one cipher in three parts. The envelope reconstruction carries a LEGIBLE ink 408 grid as the opening image; the demand is display type. No Australian front page (regression RC4).

b0b.motion: grid reveal; 51 YEARS static (the cut IS the event)
b0b.why: Narration: broken in days / held out 51 years / never identified. 51 YEARS is the first hard cut — biggest type in the film, 340 grid beside it, date range chip.

b0c.why: Method footnotes demoted (RC4): three text rows with colored ticks, no paper cards, smaller footprint than v3.

b0d.why: Brand moment over the credited Golden Gate overlook photo (re-identified in v4 frame review; was mislabeled Chronicle building) — title backed by substance.

b1a.motion: lateral track; map reveals; names type on
b1a.why: New fact (first attack, new date/place) = hard cut. Photo IS the scene; victims' names as lower-third text on the frame, no beige card (RC3).

b1b.mode: two-plate hard cut + map inset + lower-third
b1b.motion: rise on A, cut to push-in on B mid-block
b1b.why: Two real places in one narration (Vallejo + the park above it) — mid-block photo cut gives the block two visuals.

b1c.motion: push-in on the lake; names type on
b1c.why: The legend attack: the aerial is the strongest asset in the pool — give it the full frame; hood/crosshair described by narration, never drawn.

b1d.why: The last attack: Presidio Heights context photo, Stine lower-third, partial print called out by narration.

b1e.why: Summary breath after four attacks: dissolve in, city context, four consequence chips.

b2a.motion: envelopes rise sequentially, middle card breathes scale
b2a.why: The three-envelope artifact composition IS the story; envelopes enlarged vs v3, demand as quote bar.

b2b.motion: close crop on the wire-machine keys
b2b.why: The name arrives: typed line with a contrast band, close crop of the period newsroom (typewriter_keys.jpg REJECTED — watermarked stock preview, directive §6).

b2c.motion: slow push; rows type on right
b2c.why: The taunting campaign at night: crosshair motif over a period night street; claims vs confirmed as text, CLAIM≠CONFIRMED stamp.

b2d.motion: macro hold, slow zoom on the stamp
b2d.why: The letters were the best evidence: real stamp macro fills the frame; three evidence chips along the bottom band.

b3a.motion: grid fills left plate; rows type right
b3a.why: The 408 as a physical artifact: large paper plate with INK grid (period-true, legible — RC6), explainer rows right.

b3b.why: The human story of the solve: one wide card, bigger type than v3, FBI-corroborated stamp.

b3c.why: The message is the image: four big mono lines, then the quote bar. Clean plate for focus.

b3d.motion: quote card, then glyph strip reveals
b3d.why: The withholding: quote on paper + final 18 characters as ink boxes on a paper strip — legible this time.

b3e.why: What the 408 proved: three rows of plain text on clean plate — no paper rows (RC3).

b4a.why: New cipher = new fact = hard cut. The 340 grid is the hero at maximum size, three fact rows right.

b4b.why: Why it held 51 years: the transposition shown, glyphs brighter than v3.

b4c.motion: names type on a shared rule
b4c.why: The 2020 solve team: names on one shared baseline rule — no three-paper-cards template (RC3).

b4d.why: Same voice, still no name: message lines with the habitual misspelling highlighted.

b4e.why: Competent amateur: the two ciphers side by side, one extra trick called out.

b5a.why: The two unsolved artifacts over the real Mount Diablo tower (the Z32 map claim references it).

b5b.why: Underdetermination shown honestly: one string, four plausible readings, none verifiable.

b5c.why: Identity evidence was physical: the case board fills the frame; four rows on a contrast band (fix from frame review).

b6a.why: The suspect file is the period artifact here — one large file card with tab, THEORY stamp.

b6b.motion: rows type on with NO MATCH stamps
b6b.why: Excluded on the case's own evidence: three clean rows, red stamps, no paper wall.

b6c.why: 2021 viral claim tested and rejected: claim and response on one document card.

b6d.why: The repeating pattern: four nodes, amber arrows, the lesson line under.

b7a.why: 1969 itself is the answer: period street + Bay Area map + four constraint rows on band.

b7b.motion: bars fill; stamp; limits type on
b7b.why: 2002 partial profile: marker-bar visualisation with the hard limit stamped and stated.

b7c.why: The full record in four numbers (5/2/2/0) as giant display numerals over the bridge — the recap should be SEEN from the back row.

b8a.why: The verdict begins: five check rows on clean plate.

b8b.why: The open questions, as sharp as the proofs.

b8c.why: Resolution: the bay, the three closing lines, the rule.

b8d.why: The case remains open; jurisdictions; sources note.
